papers.authors: Tianyu Fu, Ruoxi Wang, Zihan Min, Zhongqi Ren, Zhihao Li, Tengxuan Liu, Shengxu Mu, Hanling Zhang, Yu Wang
papers.evidence: 智能体直接控制活跃KV缓存增长，避免重预填充
papers.tldr: LLM智能体处理复杂任务时轨迹不断变长，键值缓存I/O与存储逐渐成为主要成本，轨迹还可能超过模型上下文上限，必须控制活跃缓存增长。已有上下文工程通过裁剪或摘要历史来缩小缓存，但修改轨迹前缀会使后续缓存失效，并触发保留上下文的昂贵重预填充，保留过少又损害准确率。本文提出缓存工程，让智能体直接用drop把选定缓存移出未来注意力、用repos调整保留键的位置编码，从而不改轨迹也能控制活跃KV缓存。作者还协同设计AKV服务引擎以处理缓存操作带来的历史依赖，实验显示平均成本降低27.7%，P95延迟最高提速1.5倍。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.

papers.title_en: Budgeted KV-Cache Repair for Evolving Contexts
papers.authors: Han Yu, Wenhui Zhu, Jincheng Cao, Rui Cai, Yuanda Xu, Zhengze Zhou, Xiwen Chen, Hao Wang, Xuanzhao Dong, Han Shi, Menglin Zhou, Shayan Mohajer Hamidi, Lin Su, Mina Razghandi, Sayan Ghosh, Qing Lan, Rohit Jain, Alborz Geramifard
papers.evidence: 面向演化上下文的预算化KV缓存修复调度
papers.tldr: 语言模型代理更新上下文时，删除文本仍会通过残留 KV 缓存影响后续计算，而重算整个保留后缀代价高昂。为此，作者提出预算化 KV 缓存修复，并发现刷新连贯语义区域优于刷新孤立 token。基于此提出语义单元刷新（SUR），用廉价嵌入分数把预算分配给查询相关文本区域，无需训练或辅助前向。在五个模型和多个删除及多跳 QA 任务中，仅重算 2–5% 后缀即可接近全量重算效果，并显著降低碎片刷新延迟。
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents revise their working context as information becomes obsolete, but deleting text does not erase its influence on cached computation. Later key-value (KV) states remain conditioned on the deleted content, while recomputing the entire retained suffix can be costly. We introduce budgeted KV-cache repair: recovering task performance by recomputing a user-chosen fraction of the retained suffix. Comparing repair allocations under identical relevance scores and token budgets, we find that refreshing coherent regions can substantially outperform refreshing isolated tokens. This finding motivates Semantic-Unit Refresh (SUR), which allocates the budget to query-relevant text regions using inexpensive embedding scores, without training or an auxiliary transformer forward. To execute these repairs efficiently, a layer-packed executor processes selected states together at each layer while preserving full causal cache access. Across five models, SUR achieves strong recovery in controlled deletion tasks while recomputing only 2-5% of the suffix. On four natural multi-hop QA datasets, it achieves near-full-recompute exact match at a 5% budget with lower post-edit latency. The executor accelerates fragmented refresh by up to 16.1x over interval-wise execution.

papers.title_en: JointServe: Serving Multi-Model Agents on Memory-Constrained GPUs
papers.evidence: 面向智能体负载的驻留对象与统一内存预算调度
papers.tldr: 多模型智能体需要编排多个专家模型，其权重工作集常超出GPU显存，私有与边缘部署下的整模型换入换出会串行传输权重，并在切换时丢失会话KV。JointServe将权重分片与KV块统一为竞争同一内存预算的驻留对象，利用调用意图预取、部分层驻留和抢占式传输调度，在模型被调用前提前准备并保护活跃会话。评测显示，其会话完成时间较最强整模型换基线降低21.7%，在基线均无法完成的崩溃场景中仍可用，回放SWE-bench等轨迹最高降49%，SLO达成率由2.8%–24.5%升至76.8%–100%。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are evolving from a single model calling tools to planners that orchestrate multiple expert models whose capabilities live in distinct weights. This shift breaks a hidden assumption of today's serving systems: that the working set of models fits in GPU memory. On the memory-constrained GPUs typical of private and edge deployments, naive whole-model swapping serializes weight transfer with computation and, without host-backed KV restoration, discards session state at a switch. We present JointServe, a serving system that treats weight shards and KV blocks as residency objects competing for one unified memory budget. JointServe exploits three structural properties of agent workloads (directed calls, gapped execution, and dual-state residency) to prepare models before they are called: an intent signal parsed from the caller's own output stream triggers prefetch during generation, partial k* residency reduces switching to incremental layers, and a preemptive transfer scheduler protects live-session KV with a guaranteed bandwidth share. A carve-out control step adjusts the weight/KV allocation as workload demands change. Evaluations show that JointServe reduces session completion time by 21.7% over the strongest whole-model swap baseline and stays usable in a crash regime where every whole-model swap baseline fails to finish (a 46-fold gap). On replayed SWE-bench, tau-bench, and OSWorld traces, it cuts session completion time by up to 49% and lifts SLO attainment from 2.8-24.5% to 76.8-100%.

papers.title_en: LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Zhiwei Chen, Zhongtao Rao, Waikit Xiu, Yuxiang Zhang, Shuting Cui, Jian Chen, Tianxiang Zhao
papers.evidence: 修复多智能体系统中跨智能体共享的非前缀 KV 缓存复用问题
papers.tldr: 多智能体系统中，非前缀 KV 缓存复用能提升推理效率，但当各智能体任务相互冲突时，直接复用会让模型性能大幅下降，最高达 90%。LatentRemedy 用少量任务条件潜在 token 帮助目标智能体理解复用上下文，无需重算共享块，并通过全预填充蒸馏训练 MLP。实验显示，它在冲突任务上稳定优于现有复用基线，TTFT 随缓存增大仍接近直接复用。
papers.abstract_en: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. Specifically, we use an MLP to map the last hidden state of the target prefix into a small number of latent tokens, which are placed after the reused KV block to interact with the shared context. To guide subsequent predictions toward the target task, we train the MLP through full-prefill distillation. Experiments show that LatentRemedy consistently outperforms existing reuse baselines on conflicting tasks while maintaining TTFT close to direct reuse as cache size grows. Code and data are available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse.

papers.title_en: MemPrice: Online Memory Allocation via Adaptive Pricing for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.authors: Yiming Zong, Shiyuan Piao, Jiashuo Jiang, Fugee Tsung
papers.evidence: 自适应定价决定上下文预算下保留哪些记忆
papers.tldr: 长程LLM智能体的交互历史不断增长，但现有记忆机制多关注相关性、检索或压缩，未显式处理上下文预算在记忆与表示粒度间的分配。MemPrice将活跃上下文视为共享资源，用自适应定价按估计保留价值动态分配细节，并在每轮硬性满足预算。理论上给出不可逆压缩的线性最坏遗憾，且定价前沿下平均分配遗憾可消失；在LongMemEval、LoCoMo、AppWorld、WebShop上验证。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon LLM agents face a fundamental allocation problem as interaction histories grow: which information to retain, how much context to devote to it, and at what granularity. Existing memory mechanisms largely focus on relevance, retrieval, or compression, leaving this allocation trade-off implicit. We introduce MemPrice, which treats active context as a shared resource and dynamically allocates it across memories and representation levels. MemPrice turns accumulated memory pressure into an adaptive price on context, encouraging detail only when its estimated retention value justifies the additional footprint. This pressure persists across memory refreshes, allowing the contents of memory to evolve while preserving long-run control over context usage. We show that irreversible compression can force linear worst-case regret against hindsight following its own memory trajectory, and introduce a same-state benchmark to evaluate allocation on MemPrice's realized memory states. MemPrice enforces the hard context budget at every round and regulates long-run occupancy through adaptive pricing, without prior knowledge of the interaction horizon. Under priced-frontier regularity, its average allocation-regret bound against this benchmark vanishes when accumulated estimation error is sublinear. We evaluate the framework under matched memory budgets on LongMemEval, LoCoMo, AppWorld, and WebShop across three foundation models, spanning both query-blind memory construction and goal-directed agent context management.

papers.title_en: Think Before You Speak: Enabling Training-Free Latent Communication Between Language Models
papers.evidence: 多个语言模型智能体之间直接共享 KV 缓存而无需文本交换
papers.tldr: 多智能体语言模型通常依赖文本交换信息，带来传输瓶颈与下游预填充延迟；已有KV缓存共享方案需为每对模型训练融合适配器，难以实用部署。CacheFuse提出免训练方法，用线性插值将上游模型的KV缓存增强下游模型，实现异构模型间的隐式通信。在四个推理与知识基准上，它较单模型基线最高提升8.6个百分点准确率，并相较文本通信取得最高12.2倍TTFT加速。该工作降低了隐式协作的部署门槛，为多模型高效协同提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks in coding, mathematical logic, and iterative reasoning, especially by coordinating effectively within multi-agent systems (MAS). However, language agents traditionally communicate via text exchange, which introduces a bottleneck in information transfer and adds prefill latency for downstream agents. Recent work proposes that directly sharing the key-value (KV) cache between language models can enable efficient latent collaboration, entirely bypassing standard text-based communication. To enable latent communication between heterogeneous models of different sizes, prior work introduces trained fusion adapters for each model pair, which limits practical deployment. We introduce CacheFuse, a training-free method which demonstrates that augmenting a downstream model with an upstream model's KV cache using linear interpolation consistently enables superior performance than the standalone downstream model can achieve. We systematically analyze CacheFuse across four reasoning and knowledge benchmarks and demonstrate up to 8.6 percentage points higher accuracy compared to single-model baselines and up to 12.2x TTFT speedup compared to text-based communication in multi-model inference.

papers.title_en: Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Jianghong Zhou, Hao Rong, Chen Lin, Daoan Zhang
papers.evidence: 智能体记忆与缓存的安全复用及过期条目检测
papers.tldr: 论文提出“推理收缩”：模板、技能库、记忆和缓存把多步推理压缩为一步，但事实变化后旧记忆会静默出错。作者证明基于成功/失败计数的记忆信任机制是迟钝的变化检测器，并提出按似然比加权失败、对照实时推理认证、事实变化即重启证书的安全复用方法。在五个LLM的多跳事实编辑任务中，计数式记忆的过期答案比认证记忆多7.0–13.5倍，代码任务多35–73倍。该工作揭示安全记忆复用的认证负载与缩放规律。
papers.abstract_en: Thought templates, skill libraries, agent memories and caches turn many reasoning steps into one. We call this reasoning contraction. A contracted memory saves reasoning steps and errors until its facts change, then quietly answers wrong. Most systems trust memories by counting successes and failures. We prove that such counters are badly tuned change detectors: a symmetric counter notices a partial change only after a power of its false-alarm horizon, and an unclipped one may never notice it. On five LLMs answering multi-hop questions over edited facts, ExpeL- and ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x more stale answers than certified memories given the same information, and on code tasks with an exact verifier 35-73x more. Safety also has a price. When facts change and each memory is judged only by its own verified outcomes, one number, the certification load, sets how much reasoning any safe memory can skip, and under Zipf demand it yields a scaling law. Our recipe weighs each memory's failures by its own likelihood ratio, certifies its utility against live reasoning, and restarts the certificate when facts change, with the likelihood-ratio detector as the safety net for unannounced changes; for large edits it also invalidates the memory.

papers.title_en: SCARCE: Emergent Institutions in Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Coding Systems
papers.authors: Abhinav Kumar, Rediet Abebe, Eugene Bagdasarian, Sahar Abdelnabi
papers.evidence: 智能体通过协商获取共享执行资源
papers.tldr: 多智能体在长程编码任务中需共享编译、测试等执行资源，协调失当可能引发安全风险。SCARCE让多个智能体在各自截止期下完成编码任务，并协商共享执行资源的访问时机与时长。实验发现智能体会自发形成基于声誉、互惠与先例的非正式制度，这些制度跨任务持续并影响资源分配。作者建立21类谈判策略与规范分类法，审计8个模型、逾1500条轨迹，发现前沿模型更常表现出制度行为，同时存在排他联盟与罕见的分而治之策略。
papers.abstract_en: As autonomous agents become widely deployed, coordinating access to shared computing resources and services will become increasingly important. Recent incidents have already revealed unplanned coordination between agents, highlighting the safety implications of these interactions. Yet prior studies of agent negotiation often use stylized games and simulated bargaining, leaving open how these behaviors develop during sustained, long-horizon tasks. We propose SCARCE (Shared Compute ARena for Coding agEnts), a framework in which agents solve sequences of coding tasks under individual deadlines while negotiating access to a shared execution resource. This negotiation determines when and for how long they can inspect programs, compile code, and run tests. We find that agents spontaneously develop informal institutions: persistent rules and commitments grounded in reputation, reciprocity, and precedent. These arrangements, which we call institutional behaviors, carry across tasks and influence resource allocation, with agents sometimes forgoing immediate advantages to honor earlier agreements. We develop a 21-category taxonomy of negotiation strategies and emergent norms and use it to analyze eight models and audit more than 1,500 trajectories across different environmental settings. Among the models tested, newer frontier models exhibit more institutional behaviors than older or lightweight models. Alongside cooperation, we observe exclusionary coalitions and rare divide-and-conquer strategies. SCARCE provides a controlled setting for proactively and systematically auditing how these relationships emerge, shape access to resources, and affect the safety and coordination of multi-agent systems.

papers.title_en: Caching Policies based on Object Sizes
papers.evidence: 考虑对象大小的缓存驱逐策略评估
papers.tldr: 缓存淘汰策略通常忽略对象长度，但对象大小会直接影响缓存成本与命中收益。本文评估长度感知的淘汰策略，在不同缓存容量与成本设置下，覆盖独立引用模型和真实生产轨迹等工作负载。针对分段缓存，进一步考察混合策略，并为SIEVE及其长度感知扩展建立工作集近似。该研究为大小感知缓存策略的设计、比较与理论分析提供了评估框架和近似工具。
papers.abstract_en: We evaluate eviction policies that consider the lengths of the objects being cached for different cache sizes (cost) and different workloads. Workloads include the Independent Reference Model and real-world production traces. In particular, hybrid policies are considered for segmented caches. A working-set approximation is developed for SIEVE as well as its length-aware extension.

papers.title_en: PriorityFEC: Deadline-Aware Streaming FEC for KV-Cache Handoff in Edge Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Han Shen, Qifu Tyler Sun, Fanyang Meng, Ye Wang, Yongsheng Liang
papers.evidence: 在截止时间约束下调度协作智能体之间的 KV 缓存交接
papers.tldr: 边缘多智能体LLM跨代理传递上下文时，重复预填充造成冗余计算；复用KV缓存又受限于严格TTFT截止与不可靠链路。PriorityFEC将高价值KV块前置形成效用感知流，并用反馈自适应流式FEC在截止前调度修复包。原型在Qwen2.5-7B与Llama-3.1-8B多数据集上任务质量优于对比传输方案，紧截止下优势更明显。该工作表明需联合优化KV缓存效用与截止感知传输可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly deployed at the edge to support complex tasks that require collaboration and information exchange among multiple agents. However, when task contexts are passed across agents, shared context that has already been processed by upstream agents often needs to be prefilled again, resulting in substantial redundant computation. Reusing an already prefilled key--value (KV) cache can avoid this recomputation, but requires the reusable KV state to be transferred across the network before the receiving agent can begin generation. Under strict time-to-first-token (TTFT) deadlines and unreliable edge links, delivering the complete KV cache may be infeasible, making it necessary to prioritize and protect the most valuable KV information within a limited transmission budget. This paper proposes PriorityFEC, a utility-aware KV-cache handoff scheme that jointly exploits model-side KV importance and transport-side reliability. PriorityFEC first constructs a utility-aware source stream by placing high-utility KV blocks at earlier transmission positions. It then protects the ordered stream using a feedback-adaptive Streaming Forward Erasure Correction (FEC) mechanism, which schedules repair packets according to receiver feedback before the TTFT deadline. We implement PriorityFEC on a distributed edge LLM serving prototype and evaluate it with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct across multiple datasets. Results show that PriorityFEC achieves superior task quality over the compared transport schemes, with its advantages becoming particularly pronounced under stringent deadline constraints. These results demonstrate the importance of jointly optimizing KV-cache utility and deadline-aware transport reliability when reusable LLM state must be handed off across unreliable edge networks.

papers.title_en: Close Enough is Nowhere Near: Fidelity-Consumability Decoupling in KV Caches
papers.authors: Adam Deng, Shicheng Liu, Yada Zhu
papers.evidence: 冻结多智能体模型之间的 KV 缓存替换
papers.tldr: 多智能体LLM以文本通信有损且浪费，直接传递KV缓存成为替代方案。论文研究冻结模型下用发送方缓存替换读者缓存的“保真替换”路线，发现其因读者侧竞争注意力而失效，几何相似度无法预测可用性。八种替换方法均仅达到无信息缓存基线。作者转而让读者保留自身缓存并将发送方缓存作为额外上下文，仅适配查询，即可超越自身基线，指出应追求缓存增补而非高保真替换。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems communicate in text, which is lossy and wasteful: the sender throws away the reading it already did. A growing literature instead transmits the KV cache, the natural carrier of that reading. We study the most appealing form of the idea: both models stay frozen and the sender's cache is substituted for the reader's with nothing trained. It does not work, and the obstruction belongs to the reader. A frozen transformer reads only caches close to the one it would have written itself, a region we call its tolerable set. We show that geometric similarity to that cache does not predict whether the reader can use it, and the failure is not gradual, so a more faithful substitute is not the remedy it appears to be. We explain this phenomenon with competitive attention. Experimentally, we test eight diverse substitution methods against two measured anchors: an uninformative cache baseline and the reader's own accuracy from having read the passage. All sit at the baseline. That turns a long tail of separate negative results into one outcome with a stated condition for overturning it. A different design does work: if the reader keeps its own cache and attends over the sender's as extra context, adapting only its queries, it beats its own baseline, and also clears the baseline with eight senders pooled where undirected attention over the same union falls below it. We offer this as a characterization on one probe, not a leaderboard claim. Our central contribution is a redirection: pursuing faithful substitute caches is the wrong target; adding a cache to what the reader already has is the promising one.

papers.title_en: Beyond Marginal Influence: Interaction-Aware Memory Selection for LLM Agents
papers.evidence: 交互感知的记忆选择选取充分子集，类似缓存准入与驱逐
papers.tldr: 现有LLM智能体记忆选择依赖相关性或个体影响力排序，在冗余或联合必要证据下难以找到充分子集。作者研究逐决策记忆充分性，构建含九类交互、六个工作流域及精确oracle的JointCoreBench，并提出按成本排序、先组后单的JointCore基线。在6912个精确条件下，JointCore 100%恢复最小成本充分集，子集评估从30.00降至11.13，节省87.8%活跃记忆；跨四个12B-70B模型，查询数与恢复率优于成本感知单条删除。该工作提供高效基准基线，但尚非可部署方案。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-agent memory selection often uses retrieval rankings based on record relevance or individual influence. Such rankings cannot identify sufficient subsets under redundant or jointly necessary evidence. We study per-decision memory sufficiency: selecting a small subset that preserves full-memory behavior. To separate search error from model error, we introduce JointCoreBench, a benchmark with nine interaction families, six workflow domains, natural-language decisions, and exact sufficient-set oracles, and JointCore, a relevance cost-ordered group-deletion baseline that tests blocks before individual records. On 6,912 exact conditions, cost-ordered JointCore recovers a minimum-cost sufficient set in 100.0% of cases, reduces subset evaluations from 30.00 to 11.13 (62.9%), and achieves 87.8% active-memory savings. Across four 12B-70B model families and 432 tasks per model, its unweighted mean is 10.28 versus 16.00 model queries and 50.6% versus 43.1% minimum-cost recovery relative to cost aware singleton deletion. Both methods preserve full-memory behavior under the deterministic primary interface. Tests with physical deletion, UNKNOWN masks, PENDING sentinels, counterfactual values, and alternative labels identify interface dependent behavior. JointCore is an efficient benchmark baseline; the study does not establish deployment-ready memory compression.

papers.title_en: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
papers.authors: Ran Zhou, Zehui Kong, Fanyu Lin, Jiaheng Liu, Zhen Zhang, Yuxiang Ren
papers.evidence: 结构感知的记忆复用，缓存技能组合以降低智能体工作流开销
papers.tldr: LLM智能体技能库扩大后，全量加载开销高，扁平语义检索又忽略依赖、执行顺序、状态转移和数据流约束。SPEM构建原子技能记忆与Skill-DAG记忆，优先复用高置信度技能组合模板，否则检索原子技能并用Skill-GNN做状态与结构感知选择，成功执行回写为新DAG。在ALFWorld达87.1%成功率、SkillsBench达38.38%奖励，并降低token与运行时间。为技能库扩展提供高效可积累的程序性记忆框架。
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. We propose SPEM, a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework for efficient skill use in LLM-based agents. SPEM maintains Atomic Skill Memory for individual skills and Skill-DAG Memory for reusable compositions derived from successful executions. For a new task, SPEM reuses high-confidence Skill-DAG templates when available. Otherwise, it retrieves atomic skills and invokes Skill-GNN for state- and structure-aware skill selection. Successful executions are written back as new Skill-DAGs, allowing procedural memory to accumulate over time. Experiments on ALFWorld and SkillsBench show that SPEM achieves the best overall effectiveness--efficiency trade-off, reaching 87.1% ALFWorld success and 38.38% SkillsBench reward while reducing token and runtime costs against strong baselines.
